title: 3D ANIMATION
description: Rigging and lifelike animations for characters, cinematic trailers, and product demonstrations.
body: Bring your characters and concepts to life with broadcast-ready 3D animation. We specialize in custom character rigging, expressive face motion capture cleanup, keyframe character animation, dynamic particle simulation, and cinematic commercial production.
benefits: Production-ready FBX/USD format exports for engines
Seamless blend of physics simulation & keyframe polish

process.desc: Define shot list, timing, camera beats, and audio synchronization.
Build inverse kinematics (IK/FK) character rigs with custom facial blendshapes.
Execute primary poses, secondary motion, overlapping action, and facial sync.
Apply raytraced studio lighting, post-processing VFX, and multi-pass compositor export.

deliverables: Full HD / 4K ProRES & MP4 Video Exports
Rigged FBX / Blend / Maya Scene Files
FBX Animation Clip Files for Game Engines
